mapper.select: SELECT a.customer_id,a.schedule_id,ro.order_id FROM appointment a JOIN repair_order ro ON ro.appointment_id=a.appointment_id WHERE a.appointment_id=#{appointmentId} AND a.engineer_id=#{engineerId} AND a.status='BOOKED' AND ro.order_status='PENDING_VISIT'
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_order SET order_status='PENDING_RESCHEDULE' WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
